identity.name: Meduza
identity.description: An independent Russian- and English-language online newspaper operating from Latvia, covering Russian politics, war, society and the wider region.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Operated by SIA Meduza Project in Latvia. Galina Timchenko is publisher/CEO and Ivan Kolpakov is editor-in-chief. Outlawed by the Russian state and funded by readers, advertising and grants.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Exiled independent newsroom outlawed by the Russian state, with a documented record of investigative reporting and criticism of the Kremlin.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC records High credibility but no parsed ideological rating; self-assessed as centrist with a strongly anti-Kremlin and pro-democracy orientation.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is secondary and framed through sanctions, oligarchs and the war economy.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Anti-Kremlin, pro-democracy and pro-Ukraine alignment, with a Russian émigré and regional audience.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC records High credibility; Meduza has a strong investigative record and named reporters, though it operates under exile and legal pressure.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: credibility High; no clean bias/factual fields parsed (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Independent Russian exile journalism, strongly anti-Kremlin and pro-democracy, with deep coverage of Russian politics, war and society.

selectionRationale: Adds independent Russian-language reporting and an exiled anti-Kremlin perspective that is otherwise absent from the catalog.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirms exile status and mission. Legal entity from Latvian registration references. Feed validated. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
